project.name: OnyxTranslate
project.stack: React 19 + Vite 7 + TypeScript 5.9 + Tailwind 4 + Convex 1.45 + Gemini 3.6 Flash (5-key rotation)

files.purpose: Server action: generates the translated PDF with pdf-lib — copies original pages, whites out text via per-item coordinates, overlays translation with Noto fonts for non-Latin scripts, chains to next language or ZIP
History mutations: saveToHistory (upsert per projectId+session) and deleteHistory
Server action: imports an exported Onyx Translate JSON, creates project + translation records, returns projectId/importedLangCodes/fileName
Convex mutations: create/update/delete projects, upsert/update chunks and translations, deleteChunksForLang, createJob, saveImageTranslation
Server action: re-parses the uploaded PDF with pdfjs-dist, groups text items into lines by Y-coordinate (2px tolerance) to fix broken words, returns pageData/fullText/wordCount

Convex reactive queries: session-scoped reads (getProject, getLatestProject), server-raw reads (getProjectRaw, getTranslationsRaw), progress (getChunkProgress, getTranslationProgress), live preview text, history, and watchdog
Convex database schema: 6 tables (projects, chunks, translations, imageTranslations, history, jobs) with indexes for session, project+lang, and status+scheduled queries

UNIFIED translation action: builds the 23-phase system prompt, runs Bible Pass + sliding-window context, calls Gemini 3.6 Flash with 5-key rotation + retries, applies cultural filters + dragon telepathy formatting + RTL marker + QA, then chains to the next language via scheduler
Server action: multimodal OCR + translation of images via Gemini 3.6 Flash with 5-key rotation, saves result to imageTranslations

Autonomous scheduler queue (legacy path kept for PDF-chain resume): startTranslation creates chunks and chains processLanguage; processChunkInternal runs Bible Pass + Gemini + post-processing + QA per chunk; cancelTranslation stops the queue
Server action: stores the original PDF in Convex File Storage, returns storageId
Server action: builds a ZIP of all completed translated PDFs plus a summary report, stores it, and updates the project record
Intro overlay: actual Kali Linux dragon logo (logo.svg) with neon glow, ember particles, gold flash sweep, ONYX/TRANSLATE title, auto-completes after ~3.7s with 4.5s safety timeout
Slide-in history panel: lists past translations for this session with status, timestamp, and delete action (Convex reactive query)
Per-language expandable accordion showing status, chunk progress, merged translation preview with RTL support, and PDF download links
Progress dashboard: active-language banner (N/20, chunk X/Y), per-language rows with progress bars, Pause/Download/Start Fresh actions
Locked glossary: magicMilitary term map + properNouns name map across all 20 languages (drives Bible Pass, prompt glossary, QA checks)

files.purpose: Type declarations for the arabic-reshaper package
Golden-sample baseline tests: BASELINE_SOURCE excerpt, per-language expectations, runBaselineTests scoring QA output
Cultural filter engine: market contexts (standard/high-censorship/romance-focused), per-language cultural rules, applyCulturalFilters, detectExplicitContent, getEuphemism
Client-side translation pipelines (legacy): runLocalizedTranslationPipeline (AI/glossary), runNeuralTranslationPipeline (transformers.js), runTranslationPipeline wrapper, model load/release
Script/format helpers: scriptConfigs, isRTL, formatDragonTelepathy (「」/【】/«»), formatQuote/Ellipse/Dash, processRTLText, preserveLineBreaks
Local neural translation via transformers.js (Xenova models): loadModel, translateChunk, disposeModel — offline fallback path
Client-side PDF rendering helper: buildTranslatedPdfBytes renders pages to canvas via pdf.js and overlays translated text (Web Worker compatible)
Web Worker for client-side PDF parsing/generation (legacy; worker entry retained for build chunking)
Client-side PDF generation using pdf.js rasterization + overlay (legacy, superseded by server-side convex/generatePdf.ts vector overlay)
Browser-side pdf.js loader + batched parser: parsePDFHeader (fast page count), parsePDFBatch (10 pages/batch with progress), splitTextIntoChunks, validateTextForTranslation

QA engine: code-level checks for the 23 localization phases — leftover-English scan, glossary hit-rate, quote balance, name/magic-term consistency, profanity, telepathy markers, length heuristic, chapter metadata — returns QAReport with score
Legacy IndexedDB persistence layer (pre-migration): saveProject/getProject, saveTranslationChunk, terminology locks, QA reports, translation PDFs. Mostly dead after Convex migration
Vendor script loader for pdf.js/transformers from /public/vendor with CDN fallback
Character voice matrix: characterVoices (Violet, Xaden, Ridoc, Dain, Tairn, Andarna), language-specific overrides, getCharacterVoice, detectCharacterInText
App entrypoint: ConvexReactClient provider, DragonIntro overlay (plays on every load, ?debug=1 shows replay button), and hash routing to the /overview documentation dashboard

Main application page: PDF upload + parse (batched, live progress), text paste, image/camera translation, multi-language picker, Begin Translation (unified action chain), progress panel, live preview, QA report, history, export/import
App TS config: ES2020, bundler resolution, strict, noImplicitAny:false (legacy lib code)
TypeScript solution file: app + node references, @/* paths
Vite config: react + vly + tailwind plugins, @ alias, manualChunks (react-vendor/jszip/lucide), ESM workers, no HMR

dataFlow.pdfUpload: handleFileSelect → parsePDFHeader (page count) → parsePDFBatch loop (10 pages/batch, setParseProgress live) → storePdfAction (Convex Storage) → parsePdfAction (server re-parse, line-grouped text) → createProjectMutation → Convex project record
dataFlow.textTranslation: startTranslation → [createProjectMutation if pasted text] → translateLanguageAction({projectId, langCode, nextLangCode, remainingLangs}) → server: chunkText(2500 words) → per chunk: sliding-window context + Bible Pass → callGemini (5-key rotation, 429/5xx retry) → restorePlaceholders → applyCulturalFilters → formatDragonTelepathy → RTL marker → runQA → updateChunk → ctx.scheduler chains next language → last language → generatePdf → zipAssembly
dataFlow.imageTranslation: handleImageUpload (downscale 1024px JPEG) → translateImageMultiLang → translateImageAction({imageBase64, langCode}) → Gemini multimodal OCR+translate → saveImageTranslation → result rendered with RTL support
dataFlow.importExport: Export: handleExportProgress reads convexProject + convexTranslations → JSON download. Import: handleImportProgress → importProjectAction({sessionId, exportJson}) → creates project + translations → returns {projectId, importedLangCodes, fileName} → setSelectedLangCodes + setCurrentPreviewLangCode + toast
dataFlow.sessionIsolation: Each browser tab gets a unique sessionId (useState initializer with crypto/sessionStorage). All client queries (getLatestProject, getProjectTranslations, getHistory) filter by sessionId; imported projects are assigned the current session's ID.
dataFlow.progressEvents: Convex reactive queries push updates: getTranslationProgress (chunk X/Y), getTranslationsRaw (per-language status), getLivePreviewText (merged text), pdfGenerating/pdfProgress on translations
